lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit nit lehu na chheejai deh ||
lines.translation: Take it each and every day, and your body shall not waste away.
At the very last instant, you shall strike down the Messenger of Death. ||1||
So take such medicine, O fool,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit khaadhai tere jaahi vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: by which your corruption shall be taken away. ||1||Pause||
Power, wealth and youth are all just shadows,
as are the vehicles you see moving around.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਨ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: deh na naau na hovai jaat ||
lines.translation: Neither your body, nor your fame, nor your social status shall go along with you.
In the next world it is day, while here, it is all night. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਦ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਧਾਂ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਘਿਉ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saad kar samadhaa(n) trisanaa ghiu tel ||
lines.translation: Let your taste for pleasures be the firewood, let your greed be the ghee,
and your sexual desire and anger the cooking oil; burn them in the fire.
Some make burnt offerings, hold sacred feasts, and read the Puraanas.
Whatever pleases God is acceptable. ||3||
Intense meditation is the paper, and Your Name is the insignia.
Those for whom this treasure is ordered,
look wealthy when they reach their true home.
O Nanak, blessed is that mother who gave birth to them. ||4||3||8||
Malaar, First Mehl:
You wear white clothes, and speak sweet words.
Your nose is sharp, and your eyes are black.
Have you ever seen your Lord and Master, O sister? ||1||
O my All-powerful Lord and Master,
By Your power, I fly and soar, and ascend to the heavens.
I see Him in the water, on the land, in the mountains, on the river-banks,
in all places and interspaces, O brother. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਦੀਏ ਨਾਲਿ ਖੰਭ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin tan saaj deee naal kha(n)bh ||
lines.translation: He fashioned the body, and gave it wings;
He gave it great thirst and desire to fly.
When He bestows His Glance of Grace, I am comforted and consoled.
As He makes me see, so do I see, O brother. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਨ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਖੰਭ ॥
lines.transliteration: na ihu tan jaaigaa na jaahige kha(n)bh ||
lines.translation: Neither this body, nor its wings, shall go to the world hereafter.
It is a fusion of air, water and fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਪੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karam hovai japeeai kar gur peer ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if it is in the mortal's karma, then he meditates on the Lord, with the Guru as his Spiritual Teacher.
This body is absorbed in the Truth. ||4||4||9||
Malaar, Third Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: nira(n)kaar aakaar hai aape aape bharam bhulaae ||
lines.translation: The Formless Lord is formed by Himself. He Himself deludes in doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar karataa aape vekhai jit bhaavai tit laae ||
lines.translation: Creating the Creation, the Creator Himself beholds it; He enjoins us as He pleases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਏਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sevak kau ehaa vadiaaee jaa kau hukam manaae ||1||
lines.translation: This is the true greatness of His servant, that he obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa bhaanaa aape jaanai gur kirapaa te laheeai ||
lines.translation: Only He Himself knows His Will. By Guru's Grace, it is grasped.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹਾ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehaa sakat sivai ghar aavai jeevadiaa mar raheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When this play of Shiva and Shakti comes to his home, he remains dead while yet alive. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ved paRai paR vaad vakhaanai brahamaa bisan mahesaa ||
lines.translation: They read the Vedas, and read them again, and engage in arguments about Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਸਹਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh trigun maaiaa jin jagat bhulaaiaa janam maran kaa sahasaa ||
lines.translation: This three-phased Maya has deluded the whole world into cynicism about death and birth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਹੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaanai chookai manahu a(n)desaa ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, know the One Lord, and the anxiety of your mind will be allayed. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham deen moorakh aveechaaree tum chi(n)taa karahu hamaaree ||
lines.translation: I am meek, foolish and thoughtless, but still, You take care of me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਾ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hohu daiaal kar daas daasaa kaa sevaa karee tumaaree ||
lines.translation: Please be kind to me, and make me the slave of Your slaves, so that I may serve You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਅਪਣਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ek nidhaan dehi too apanaa ahinis naam vakhaanee ||3||
lines.translation: Please bless me with the treasure of the One Name, that I may chant it, day and night. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak gur parasaadee boojhahu koee aisaa kare veechaaraa ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, understand. Hardly anyone considers this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਊਪਰਿ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jal oopar phen budabudaa taisaa ihu sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: Like foam bubbling up on the surface of the water, so is this world.
